mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% directly reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount models, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand across all sectors.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 4.0% fails to predict positive 20-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or t-test p > 0.05 for mean return difference.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market overheating, triggering wage inflation that forces aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months fails to produce negative 5-day returns in > 50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 3.5% and job growth rate below 0.5% monthly indicates labor market overheating, accelerating wage inflation and forcing aggressive Fed policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition fails to predict negative returns when triggered, as 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%) compel the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, suppressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% fails to predict negative 20-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or t-test p > 0.05 for mean return difference.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand for housing, correlating with strong economic growth and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST levels fail to predict positive 5-day returns with Rank IC < 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows or t-test p > 0.05 for mean return difference.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 thousand units signal weakening housing market demand, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1400 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1400 and manufacturing output below 100 signals broad economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition fails to predict negative returns when triggered, as 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100) signals reduced industrial output, indicating weak corporate investment and demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 fails to produce negative 5-day returns in > 50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
